decisions.text: arranged: rows by measure: series in different measures: one panel per measure, stacked on one time axis drawn at the foot, each with its own scale (G2.31, G2.32)
one colour for every mark: each panel holds one measure, and the panels tell them apart (G7.6)
Gross sales: type line: a regular series whose pattern of change is the point (06 DP6-1, G1.51)
Avg. customer satisfaction: type line: a regular series whose pattern of change is the point (06 DP6-1, G1.51)
Gross sales: zero included (a narrow range far from zero wants an inset)
Gross sales: the step 1 would leave 27% room above the data; 0.5 gives 0–3.5, 7 intervals, 11% room
Avg. customer satisfaction: zero is arbitrary here, not “none of it” (G2.10): truncated, the lower limit 10–20 % of the spread below the lowest value (G2.11)
Gross sales: no point markers: no value is isolated and no straight run hides one
Gross sales: the unit phrase on the top label: “$3.5 million (gross sales)”; the top gridline starts after it
Gross sales: labels as a set, 1 decimals: 0.0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5, 3.0, $3.5
Gross sales: digits hidden: millions, stated once on the top label (R2-05, D-3): “$3.5 million (gross sales)”
Avg. customer satisfaction: no point markers: no value is isolated and no straight run hides one
Avg. customer satisfaction: the unit phrase on the top label: “8.0 avg. customer satisfaction (on 10)”; the top gridline starts after it
Avg. customer satisfaction: labels as a set, 1 decimals: 6.5, 7.0, 7.5, 8.0
Avg. customer satisfaction: time axis: row 1 full
Avg. customer satisfaction: time axis: row 2 (“2022”) left out, the title gives it (G2.37)
a merged chart: 2 panels stacked on one time axis, drawn once at the foot; each its own scale with its unit phrase on the top label (G2.32)

source.shows: a merged chart instead of a dual axis: two lines in different units stacked on one time axis, drawn once at the foot, each panel its own scale with its unit phrase on its top label (G2.31, G2.32); the rating's zero is an anchor, so its line need not start at zero (G2.10); both lines in the single-line colour, since the panels already tell them apart (R3-3), where the book keeps the dual axis's orange and blue
